findings.summary: Carrying over the previous log's 'Met this goal' choice means the checkbox can open pre-checked, which contradicts the ContactEvent invariant that an event qualifies only when the owner explicitly marks it, and removes the earlier 'defaults unchecked' safeguard.
The prefill rule does not say what the channel, depth and Met this goal fields show when the person has no previous log, so the first-log case is left undefined.

Step c4 is the branch decision on screen.person, but it now describes the form opening prefilled; the form belongs to screen.logContact in step c5, so the behaviour is attached to the wrong step and screen.
